notes.title: Celebrate the Lunar New Year with an update and dozens of new weapon skins!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Bounty Hunters![/h2]

[b]To celebrate the Lunar New Year, we’re bringing a free content update, which includes 38 brand new weapon skins for free and fixes some minor bugs![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40106390/fb56affd898c0d9b689601685f8c36ab40978e12.png[/img]

[h2]Become the most stylish bounty hunter on Necromunda[/h2]

Spruce up your guns with this [b]huge new weapon skins set![/b] Bring a brand new look to the classic Bolter, the devastating Plasma Gun, and many more -[b] pick from the 38 new skins and parade your choices proudly in the Underhive.[/b] This new free content is available now, so [b]get to work to unlock them[/b], Bounty Hunter, and instill fear in your targets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40106390/b9cdee4808c4349a36096041726cf79098e0925d.png[/img]

Finally, for anyone still hesitating to delve into the heart of the Underhive, [b]Necromunda: Hired Gun and DLCs are up to 38% off on Steam![/b] Enjoy[b] a significant discount on the bundle with the game, the OST and Artbook. [/b]
Grab your new guns, Necromunda: Hired Gun awaits its newest Bounty Hunter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40106390/772458ab00e0f69df0a550a068f52e1804fde39e.png[/img]

notes.title: The Gang Wars Cosmetics Bundle is now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Bounty Hunters![/h2]

It’s time to embody your favourite Necromunda Gang with [b]three new sets of skins![/b] Hunt down your prey with style by wearing the colours of the [b]Goliath, Escher or Nautica gangs![/b]

With the recently released [b]free [i]Hellhound[/i] pack, players can add yet another set of skins[/b] as they eliminate high-value targets to further augment their deadly bodies. This cosmetic pack comes with unique cosmetics for your knife, outfit, and mastiff. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40106390/c99b571dc197fd6f0ba1f17bf5a14f82e4934f35.png[/img]

The[i] Gang Wars Cosmetics Bundle[/i] contains [b]three new cosmetic sets with different looks for your outfit, knife, loyal cyber-mastiff, and chew toy. Each set is themed around one of the aforementioned gangs.[/b] 
Pick a side or die alone, there’s no in between.

[b]The [i]Gang Wars Cosmetics Bundle[/i] is available now. [i]Necromunda: Hired Gun[/i] is also available on Steam.[/b]

notes.title: The Patch 4 has arrived!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Bounty Hunters![/h2]
The fourth patch is now live on Steam and brings various stability and QoL improvements! 
For this update, we mainly focused on improving the overall stability of the game and on bug fixes.
Thanks a lot for your continued support of the game!

[h2]Patch Content[/h2]
[b]New features[/b]

- Add a third slot for long weapons
- Takedowns are now limited by a Takedown gauge that replenishes itself with time or when the player deals damages.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Global improvements of stability and performances
- Fix a bug with the skins menu of looted weapons which was empty
- Multiple minors bug fixes

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xZWk158.gif[/img]
[i]Hope you celebrated the International Dog Day last August 26![/i]

That’s it for today! 
Make sure to stay updated on the game by following us on social media: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayHiredGun]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayHiredGun]Facebook[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/jpvMw9w5UJ]Discord[/url]
We’ll see you in the hive, Bounty Hunters!

[i]-The Focus Entertainment and StreumOn Studio teams[/i]

notes.title: The third patch is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AdtFCUK.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Greetings Bounty Hunters![/h2][/b]
[b]The third patch is now live on Steam![/b]
This patch, based on your feedback as always, brings [b]various improvements, new features, and bug fixes.[/b] For this update, we mainly focused on bringing [b]new anticipated features like replacing the default stubgun with another one[/b], on top of various bug fixes.

[b]Thanks for your support, we’ll keep working on improving the game![/b] Now, let’s go through the patch content!

[b][h2]Patch Content[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]New features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*]Opening the weapon wheel or the cyber wheel now triggers slow motion (this feature can be turned off in the settings)
[*]The mandatory stubgun can now be replaced by another stubgun[/b]
[*]The limitation system on takedowns is now removed. A new takedown system is still in internal tests in order to potentially be added in a future patch.
[*]Added AMD FSR support
[*]Tweaks to smoothen Mastiff animations (moving, turning etc..)
[*]Added a Mastiff animation when performing a takedown on enemies on their back
[*]Update on Ogryn ragdolls to be less "boneless"
[*]Friendly NPCs are now targeted by the mortars instead of getting instant killed in the Citadel
[/list]

[h3][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] If an NPC is stuck in the Hypogean Citadel, the current wave is automatically considered as won to avoid blocking the player
[*] Perfect aim widget should not stay displayed anymore on targets when they burrow or teleport
[*] Multiple tweaks on spawns in secondary missions
[*] Update on grapnel to reduce the chances to get stuck in a wall after grappling an enemy next to a wall
[*] Fixed a bug when an achievement wasn't getting unlocked due to multiple achievement unlocks at the same time
[*] Fixed focus loss issues in armory menu
[*] Ogryn Tesla doesn't remain stuck in his electric shock animation anymore
[*] Ambot back-mounted missile launcher is now properly destroyed and falls with the other pieces when it enters its second phase
[*] The main target of the Crush power is now always damaged to avoid the situation where the target manages to get out of the damage during the teleport
[*] Players can now destroy Ghasts and Perturbator objectives with strength booster (kick or knife)
[*] Bosses should not be afraid of the player anymore when using a stim
[*] Fixed a bug where the low life sound effect would be triggered when opening a chest
[*] Fixed a bug where the floor in Steelway would not get destroyed by the mines
[*] Veerax now has a green outline
[*] The drill in Citadel doesn't have an outline after breaking the door
[*] The Araneus Ventri boat doesn't shake the camera anymore
[/list]

That’s it for today’s patch. We hope you’ll enjoy it! We’re still working on improvements, so stay tuned for future updates!

[b]Make sure to stay updated on the game by following us on social media: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayHiredGun]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayHiredGun]Facebook[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/jpvMw9w5UJ]Discord[/url][/b]

We’ll see you in the hive, Bounty Hunters! 
 [i]-The Focus Home Interactive and StreumOn Studio teams[/i]

notes.title: The second patch is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nwiSeqe.gif[/img]

[h2]Greetings Bounty Hunters![/h2]

The second patch is now live and brings various improvements, [b]thanks to your feedback![/b] For this update, [b]we mainly focused on improving the stability of the game and reducing the stutters significantly, on top of multiple bug fixes. [/b]

As always, we want to thank you for your continued support to the game! Let’s dive into the patch content!

[h2]Patch content[/h2]

[b]New features [/b]

[list]
[*]New dialogue added when leaving a merchant shop
[*]Eschers do not have Cameleoline (invisible effect) anymore, except the Boss 
[*]New NPC melee attack variation 
[*]New sound for overloaded cells (plasma gun and pistol) 
[*]New sound for Grenade launcher Proximity grenade and high explosive grenades 
[*]Weapon reloads automatically when empty after switching weapons 
[*]If a player keeps the ADS button pressed when reloading or any action it should go back to ADS automatically 
[*]Added options to disable crosshair and enemies outline 
[*]Added a flinch animation when you rip off a shield from an Orlock with the grapnel
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes and stability [/b]

[list]
[*]Global game stability improvements
[*]Stuttering occurrences should be reduced a lot, even if it’s still work in progress 
[*]AI improvements to limit the cases where enemies stand around without trying to fight 
[*]Fixed a focus issue in the dialogue when the bartender and Kal are next to each other 
[*]Fixed arms and legs from the player which  could have an issue when dying while performing a takedown or using shock power 
[*]Archeotechs information now correctly display a number of damage instead of a range of damage 
[*]Loot bonuses: removed the % as it's technically not a percentage
[*]Avarus: When player enters wrong coordinates, the hoist goes to the wrong coordinates before triggering the alarm 
[*]Players should not get stuck in chests anymore 
[*]Fix a bug when Strength Booster was still active at the end of a mission 
[*]Tweaked the voice "mask effect" to recover some mid / low frequencies and get a better clarity in dialogue
[*]Several fixes on takedowns when the player and the enemy are not at the same height
[*]Fix the AOE damage of the Burning Sun
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]

[list]
[*]Balancing on some mastiff implants and large NPC HPs 
[*]The mastiff now attacks by himself in a larger area 
[*]Greater range of Goliath missile launchers
[/list]

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

That’s it for today! Our team will keep working on improvements based on your feedback, so don’t hesitate to let us know your thoughts on this patch! 

[b]Make sure to stay tuned by following us on our social media: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayHiredGun]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayHiredGun]Facebook[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/jpvMw9w5UJ]Discord[/url][/b]

We’ll see you in the hive, Bounty Hunters!

[i]- The Focus Home Interactive and StreumOn Studio teams[/i]

notes.title: Necromunda: Hired Gun's first patch fixes aim down sights and audio mixing
notes.content:
A first patch has arrived for Warhammer 40K FPS game Necromunda: Hired Gun. Coming just about a week after the game's launch, this patch makes a few much-needed improvements, although some of the bigger issues will need some more time for the developers to address.

One significant issue addressed in this first patch is an incorrect offset that occurs randomly in aiming alignment, which translates to gunsights being off a bit. Hired Gun is, of course, a first-person shooter, so having sights line up properly is pretty important (although the auto-aim is remarkably forgiving, particularly while you're wall-running). If you're playing Hired Gun with a controller, there's been a rework of aim assist while switching to iron sights, which should be a welcome fix as well.

Several audio issues have also been addressed, including some weird voiceover mixing and a problem with missing sound effects while in levels. That means you'll be able to hear every syllable of Space Cockney as you're bursting merc skulls in the Underhive. Pleasant!

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:

notes.title: First Patch is live!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C6mVwNF.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Hello Bounty hunters![/h2][/b]
We have been reading your comments and compiling suggestions since the release a few days ago. [b]Thank you so much for your feedback![/b]
 
We also hope that you like the [b]Warhammer Skulls event[/b] and the Corsair skin set that comes with it! For those wondering where to get the skin for your Bounty Hunter, simply talk to the Barmaid in Martyr’s End.

We’re happy to release our [b]first patch on Steam.[/b] It includes various fixes based on your reports since launch. This is only a first step and we continue to work on various topics, including the stutters that some of you encounter. You can check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1222370/view/3040472934143484125]last community update[/url] for more info about what we are working on. Without further ado, let’s dig into this patch!

[b][h2]Patch content[/h2][/b]
You will find below the main fixes that this patch is bringing:

[b]Audio[/b]
[list][*]Dialogue sound mixing improvements (global VO volume increased)
[*]Added missing sound FXs in levels[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fix a possible blocker during the Takedown tutorial
[*]Fix of a random bug causing an incorrect offset in aiming alignment
[*]Fix of Numpad keys triggering unexpected behaviours ingame
[*]Invert camera setting doesn't apply on the wheel selection anymore
[*]Fix of a bug when opening a menu while Strengh Booster is still active
[*]Various fixes[/list]
[b]Gamepad[/b]
[list][*]Rework of the Aim Assist when the player switch to iron sight[/list]
[b][h2]Thank you![/h2][/b]
That’s it for today’s patch! We are still working on more time consuming fixes, such as stuttering, FPS issues and various other bugs. The game will keep improving, so stay tuned!

[b]Don’t forget to follow our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/PlayHiredGun]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayHiredGun/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/jpvMw9w5UJ]Discord[/url]) to get the latest news about the game or to discuss it![/b]

See you in the hive!

notes.title: Second Community Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0zxYjXZ.gif[/img]

[h2]Hi everyone,[/h2]

We’ve been having a blast seeing all of you shoot your way through the mad sprawl of Necromunda since Hired Gun launched yesterday! [b]Thank you all so much for playing, for your support, and for your feedback and bug reports.[/b] These are invaluable to us as we work on our first patches.

Getting here has been an incredibly exciting journey. [b]We may be a small team but we made our game LOUD.[/b] The team are all delighted to hear that our efforts to create fun, impactful gunplay has been appreciated. [b]We’re super passionate about Warhammer 40k[/b] and it feels absolutely wonderful to hear how many of you say we’ve gotten the universe’s sound, look, and aesthetic right. [b]Thank you! [/b]

[b]Tomorrow the Warhammer Skulls event kicks off,[/b] bringing massive deals across the Warhammer franchise. Hired Gun will of course join in on the fun, [b]with a 15% discount until June 10.[/b] We will also be [b]adding a Corsair skin set[/b] (male and female), [b]and new knife skin[/b] in celebration of this event, [b]available for free to everyone[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40106390/aa5cea360af4505e54b3d4f0dcd9e476b3c67362.jpg[/img]

[h2]What are we working on?[/h2]

With that said, we’re aware of several technical issues that need to be resolved. [b]We want to assure you we’re working our hardest to fix these as soon as possible.[/b] Please read on for more details about what exactly we’re working on and prioritizing.
[olist]
[*] [b]Gamepad controls on PC[/b]: The aim assist is currently not working as it should, and there are issues with the sensitivity settings. We’re already finding fixes to these issues and should have these fixed for you in our first update.
[*] [b]Performance and stuttering[/b]: We’ve seen your reports on this issue, including from higher end PCs. While this is definitely a priority for us, fixing this may come gradually across more than one update, since it is an unexpected and complex problem to solve.
[*][b] Crashes[/b]: We’ve already identified and fixed a number of issues, and are doing our best to get these into an update soon. More fixes on this front will follow.
[*][b] Sound Mixing[/b]: We’ve identified a fix, though it’s proving a time-consuming process. That said, we have already made improvements for our next update.
[/olist]
[b]Here is the full list of fixes that will arrive in our first update:[/b]

[list]
[*] A large number of crash fixes (Create/load saves, etc.)   	
[*] Dialogue sound mixing improvements (global VO volume increased) 
[*] Added missing sound FXs in levels	
[*] Takedown tutorial bug fix which caused you to get stuck 	
[*] Gamma settings screen game freeze        	
[*] A fix for the 'Who needs weapons' achievement
[*] Fixes for animations in some cutscenes    	
[*] Aiming down sights: incorrect aiming fixed   
[*] FOV bug when aiming down sights
[/list]
[b]Additional issues that we are currently working on.[/b] They have not been fixed at the time of writing, but some improvements listed below may still make it into this early patch. 

[list]
[*] Gamepad: Aim Assist system fixed  
[*] Sensitivity and dead zone settings (bug fix)  
[*] Stutters (enemy spawns, LODs, loot management, asynchronous loading)         	
[*] Dialogue sound mixing in cutscenes (fine tuning)  	
[*] Various fixes on enemy AIs   
[/list]
We don’t have an exact ETA on when the update will arrive yet, but it will be as soon as possible and we will keep you informed.

[b]Thank you all for playing Necromunda: Hired Gun! Keep your eye out for more updates from us as we work on further patches.[/b]

[i]- The Streum On and Focus Home Teams
[/i]
